title: Publish manifest v1
description: Contract between a content generator (e.g. Hermes) and a publishing agent (e.g. Grokbot). Written by the generator as publish-manifest.json in <inbox>/<project>/<post_id>/, followed LAST by READY.json. The generator never sets approval; approval lives only in the publisher's approvals ledger.

post_id.description: Stable, unique per project, never reused for different content. A content change gets a NEW post_id and sets supersedes.

project.description: Must equal a projects/<project>.json config id.

created_by.description: Agent or person that ran the generator, e.g. hermes

index.description: 1-based display order; index 1 is the cover.

file.description: Path relative to the manifest folder.

caption.description: Full post text exactly as it will be pasted, hashtags included. UTF-8, LF line endings, no trailing newline.

hashtags.description: Every hashtag in caption, in order of appearance, with leading #. Must equal the hashtags parsed from caption.

checked_at.description: ISO date or date-time of the last check by the generator.

reverify_by.description: ISO date after which content must not be published without re-verification.

expires_at.description: Hard post-by date (e.g. a deadline the post refers to). null = none.

conflicts.description: Unresolved source conflicts. Must be empty to publish.

engagement_claims.description: Any quoted comment/reply/testimonial shown in the assets must be listed here with a real link.

approval_state.description: Generator's view only. 'approved' is intentionally not allowed: approval exists only in the publisher's ledger.

content_fingerprint.description: See FINGERPRINT in HERMES_HANDOFF.md: fp1 over ordered asset hashes + caption + hashtags.

supersedes.description: post_id this manifest replaces, if any.
